sources.title: Start where your records are.
sources.body: Choose a source to see the same promise in action: Suq reads what arrived, proposes a structure, and leaves uncertain meaning for you to confirm.
sources.promise: No fixed column names. No required order. You confirm the meaning before totals change.

previews.csv: A comma-separated sales file with Spanish headers and European currency values.
previews.excel: A workbook whose first useful row begins below a merchant-written title.
previews.paste: Rows copied directly from a working sheet without renaming any columns.
previews.json: Nested order records whose item lines need to be separated from order details.
previews.pos: A register export with product codes, quantities, totals, and local timestamps.
previews.marketplace: An order export with marketplace-specific names and additional attributes.
previews.image: A photographed paper table with recognized cells linked to their source regions.
previews.pdf: A digital or photographed report whose table structure is reconstructed for review.
previews.manual: A simple daily entry channel for recording sales while work is happening.
previews.api: Versioned records sent by an approved system through the programmatic sync boundary.

problems.title: Your data should not need a new job before it can help you.

different.title: Every export looks different.
different.body: Columns move, headings change, and dates mean different things. A rigid template makes normal records feel broken.

cleanup.title: Manual cleanup steals the decision window.
cleanup.body: By the time the sheet is ready, the stock decision is already late and the reason for a sales change is harder to see.

certainty.title: A confident wrong answer is worse than no answer.
certainty.body: Suq keeps uncertainty visible, shows the evidence, and asks before an interpretation changes your totals.

how.title: From messy records to a useful morning view.
how.body: Suq separates understanding the source from committing it. That small review boundary is what keeps flexible ingestion trustworthy.
how.tabLabel: How Suq turns records into answers

add.title: Add what you have
add.body: Use a file, photo, pasted table, or entry channel.

confirm.title: Confirm what it means
confirm.body: Inspect types, uses, confidence, samples, and evidence.

see.title: See what matters
see.body: Only supported answers appear; missing concepts are explained.

add.dropTitle: Add the record you already use
add.dropBody: Nothing needs to be renamed first. Suq profiles the actual headers and values before proposing what they mean.

see.answer: Revenue is up 18%, led by Canvas Tote and Ground Coffee.
see.evidence: Based on 312 confirmed transactions from the selected period.
see.unavailableReason: No confirmed cost field was found. Add or map cost to enable this answer.

evidence.label: Interpretation evidence
evidence.title: Review “{{field}}”
evidence.locale: The source uses Spanish labels and European number formatting.

facts.date: Values repeat across line items and parse consistently as day-first dates.
facts.amount: Values match quantity multiplied by unit price across sampled rows.
facts.code: Values are short and repeat across orders, but the abbreviated header is ambiguous.
facts.customer: Values recur across separate dates and resemble stable customer identifiers.
facts.notes: Free-text values vary and do not match a required analytical concept.

effects.date: Enables period grouping and day-aware comparisons.
effects.amount: Enables revenue totals and sales comparisons.
effects.code: Confirming item identity enables product momentum and stock matching.
effects.customer: Enables returning-customer analysis when identity is confirmed.
effects.notes: The original values remain preserved and available for filtering.
